audit.why: 51.83% over 328 games with FAV / 4/10 is consistent: Quinn denies stacks all lane, Nasus reclaims the game if it runs long. Carry threat 10/10 is right for a stacked Nasus.
audit.corrected: Rating and diff left alone; only the reason text was sharpened to name Siphoning Strike as the thing the blind denies.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Quinn, Quinn, Quinn, Quinn, Quinn, Skill, Skill. The packet reads Quinn, Quinn, Quinn, Quinn, Nasus, Quinn, Quinn — and the page's own prose already argues the packet's version.
audit.why: whys[4] says Nasus free-farms stacks during your roam window (that is a Nasus row, not a Quinn one). whys[5] says your first item keeps you ahead of a pre-Sheen Nasus, and whys[6] says you are still ahead in tempo — both Quinn rows. The chart contradicted its own explanations.
audit.corrected: Rows 4, 5 and 6 re-proposed as one atomic group across both layers: level 6 to Nasus, first item and 2+ items to Quinn. Ratings adjusted to match so the row and the number agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer says 'Q-blind his trade window' without ever naming what is being denied, and never mentions Fury of the Sands' percent-health damage.
audit.why: Siphoning Strike is an auto-attack reset (255 range, 7.5/6.5/5.5/4.5/3.5s) — Blinding Assault makes that attack whiff, which costs him the stack, not just the damage. That is the single most valuable interaction in the lane and it was implied, never stated. Fury of the Sands is flagged percentHealth: stacking armour is the wrong answer to it.
audit.corrected: Blind restated as stack denial against Siphoning Strike with its cooldown. Wither given its 15/14/13/12/11s. Fury of the Sands stated as percent-health damage plus bonus resists, so armour buys nothing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown breakdown listed only Wither, and with no number.
audit.why: The punishable cooldown that decides the lane is actually Siphoning Strike's wind-up versus your blind; Wither at 15s is the one that ends your kite.
audit.corrected: Both written into breakdown.cooldowns with real numbers.

edits.before: Behind Enemy Lines exports your lead — roam on every shove. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Nasus's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Fury of the Sands adds percent-health damage and resists, so armour won't save you — and every roam pays for his free stacks.

edits.before: Youmuu's Ghostblade is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Wither's cooldown.
edits.after: Youmuu's lands before his Sheen — force fights now, on Wither's 15s window, while his stacks are low.

edits.before: Bully him early — poke and deny his stacks, roam. Quinn wins the Wither cooldown windows.
edits.after: Bully him early — blind Siphoning Strike and deny stacks. Quinn wins every window Wither is down.

edits.before: His only kite. Poke before it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His only kite, 15s at rank 1. Engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Nasus wastes Wither — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Blinding Assault whiffs Siphoning Strike — that stack is gone.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Wither guts move and attack speed — inside it you cannot kite out.

edits.before: Vaulting INTO the fight to feel like an assassin — Vault is your spacing reset, not an engage.
edits.after: Fury of the Sands deals percent health, so your armour buys nothing — close it out before three items.

edits.before: Track Nasus's Wither: His only kite. Poke before it. When it is down — Vault-blind + R him.
edits.after: Wither, 15s: his only kite. Blinding Assault denies the Siphoning Strike auto and its stack.

edits.before: - Nasus Wither: matchup-defining — His only kite. Poke before it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Nasus Wither, 15/14/13/12/11s: his only kite, and the end of yours. - Siphoning Strike, 7.5s down to 3.5s: an auto reset — blind the wind-up and the stack is denied too. - Your ultimate: roam tempo, not a duel button.

edits.before: Once Nasus has Wither + stacked Q and tank items, his slow pins you and his percent-true-ish damage outscales your squishy lethality build.
edits.after: Once Nasus has Wither, stacked Q and tank items, Fury of the Sands piles on percent-health damage plus bonus resists — your armour buys nothing.

edits.before: Survive to two items where his lifesteal R and tank HP flip the duel
edits.after: Survive to three items where Fury of the Sands and tank HP flip the duel

notes: The blind-denies-the-stack interaction is the whole matchup and the content layer had it while the full layer only gestured at it; that asymmetry is now closed. Ratings were adjusted alongside the three flipped rows so a Nasus row no longer carries a 7/10 Quinn-favoured number.
